verdict.rationale: Coinbase documents a first-party CDP SDK with x402 building blocks (agentic wallets, TypeScript SDK functions for Bazaar discovery, generated OpenAPI client) that AI-native builders can use to build both buyer and seller integrations, plus MCP tool-call support for agents. Missing for 10: broader multi-language SDK coverage beyond TypeScript/CDP SDK, a working public OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), and independent hands-on developer confirmation specifically praising the official SDK (community examples mostly build custom wrappers rather than citing the SDK directly).
